request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #323

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/323#issuecomment-6867078177, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-fb6e`.
- Outputs: new report-only directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C13/endpoints/ADB991-claude-20261113-fb6e/` (`README.md`, `hashes.json`). No manuscript, ledger, existing-record, shared-file or `Lean/` edit.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: prepared by Claude (Anthropic) for ADB991.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is the phase-1 matching audit of the C13 join "order-zero Station renewal versus derivative-comparison supplier". The join is recorded in `selected-history-limits.tex` l.161–175, in `results/C13/completion-20261113.md` join 1 and in review #213.

**Established, reading the source textually.**
- The `0` in `Station.anew : Cash.Renewed 0 0 V V H` is `Renewed`'s polynomial shape-weight exponent: `thinPay k = ours 0 k 0 0` and `reward k = (∏ text)(1+shapeW)^k`. It is not a derivative order, and `Renewed` bounds values only.
- The station's own parameter `j` is the derivative order (`Brush`/`Mode`/`Ore` = `ContDiffAt` of order `j` with `normJ i ≤ u d^i`).
- On the auxiliary inputs used by `Pith.shall` → `ballad`/`swaths`, the ordered derivative prices of the C09 comparison are supplied at order `j ≥ B.order` on the same auxiliary `Cash` chartlet, by:
  - `Station.N`: `Utopia.stream`, `Captain.permitAverage`;
  - `Station.army`: `Armada.purchases`, with `stone = 2^j·B·meant k`, which is the manuscript's cluster criterion for `2^j u_P` with ratio 1/2.
- The same-input identity comes from `Lands.deposits`/`safeTrans`/`bank`/`spirit`.
- `Station.anew` is never projected anywhere in `Lean/YM`.
- So the source route needs no value-order continuity theorem, and no missing item was found.

**Remaining.**
- S1: a manuscript statement that the auxiliary chartlet of `selected-nonlinear-offering.tex` satisfies the incoming hypotheses of `sec:activity-jet-assembly` / `sec:parameter-comparison-suppliers` at the stage coupling. This is a matching statement, not a new estimate.
- Q1: how the Captain weight exponent `k` relates to `j`; the manuscript pays `(1+s)^j` with a reserve instead.
- Not traced: whether the `Pith.shall` chain consumes `army`/`fleets`.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` (Lean tree `328ad19b`, identical on `main` and on the base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `9c921842`).
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units. Lean and mathematics were not verified."
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - Textual reads (`sed`/`grep`) of the 31 Lean files and 9 manuscript/record files hashed in `hashes.json`; `grep -rnw anew Lean/YM`.
- Checks not performed and why:
  - No Lean elaboration (Mathlib hosts are blocked in this environment), so anonymous destructuring of `Station` is excluded only textually.
  - No LaTeX build (no `.tex` changed).
  - Not read: `Mixed.Allowed`, `Mixed.Costs.ceiling`, the bodies of `Oboe.ell`, `Empire.prom`, `Utopia.whittle`, `Gables.vendee`, `Rain.jersey`, `Pane.affords`.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none (report only). Phase 2, for the C13 author: replace the caveat at `selected-history-limits.tex` l.170–175 and the C13 ledger row by D1–D5 of the report, and add S1.
